season.evidence: Pages found say the Catwalk needs waiting until mid-July for snow and July-September is the favourable window; logged ascents peak in August (41), then September (21), July (26).

track.why: Only route on the peak; Jul 26 2025 solo climb from the Sol Duc trailhead via the Catwalk with a camp below Boston Charlie's and a 75 min summit push, summit 1 m from our pin, round trip back to the trailhead. Track start/end are 426/409 m from our trailhead pin (fails the 300 m rule); I could not confirm a better coordinate (WTA lists 47.9622,-123.8499, OSM puts the falls at 47.9518,-123.8199, which disagree), so no pin move is proposed.

facts.text: Water is thin east of Heart Lake in July: fill there, then rely on the stagnant pond near Boston Charlie's (filter it) or leftover snow; by early September the Cat Basin camp had running water.
The unmaintained Catwalk trail is overgrown with spruce and fir limbs, and the scree traverse above Boston Charlie's is hard-packed and slow (September).
Just before the Catwalk the path turns steeply uphill for about 100 ft; it is easy to miss that turn and follow a track that ends in cliffs (early July).
With lingering snow in mid-July you can scree-ski a gully southeast from about 6,300 ft back to the trail, but a washed-out chute near 5,150 ft needs careful routefinding.

notes: Trailhead pin (47.955249,-123.835839) sits 426 m from where the best round-trip track starts. The owner may want to check the true parking coordinate; I could not confirm one from fetched pages (WTA 47.9622,-123.8499 disagrees with OSM falls 47.9518,-123.8199). Summit pin fine.
